trust_center.repositoryDescription: Public Trust Center containing security, compliance, and authorization information for the Certivo Compliance Platform.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Certivo Secure Configuration Guide (version 1.1.1, effective 8 October 2026) for the Certivo Compliance Platform. Open the Resources page of the Certivo Trust Center at https://trust-gov.certivo.com/resources and select View or download on Certivo Secure Configuration Guide.

certified_services.serviceDescription: The whole cloud service offering, delivered as SaaS from AWS GovCloud (US) us-gov-west-1: the web application and API, rule evaluation, AI-assisted (LLM) processing on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US), framework orchestration, batch operations and scheduled jobs. All features of the Certivo Compliance Platform are in the FedRAMP Minimum Assessment Scope; no feature is excluded. LLM jobs call no model or service outside AWS GovCloud (US); all model calls go to Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US). Security category (FIPS 199): Moderate.

current.service_desc: Certivo is an AI-powered product and supply chain compliance platform for manufacturers and regulated industries. It replaces manual, spreadsheet-driven compliance work with a continuously maintained evidence base that links every supplier document to the parts, products, and requirements it supports.
